    int N, M, pow;
    int[] counts;
    int[][][] dp;
    
    // Recursive memoization
    int solve(int y, int i, int j) {
    	if (dp[y][i][j] != -1) return dp[y][i][j];
    	if (y == 0) {
    		if (((i|(i<<1)|(i>>1))&(pow-1))==(pow-1)) {
    			dp[y][i][j] = counts[i];
    		} else {
    			dp[y][i][j] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
    		}
    		return dp[y][i][j];
    	}
    	int best = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
    	for (int k = 0; k < pow; k++) {
    		if (((i|(i<<1)|(i>>1)|j|k)&(pow-1))==(pow-1)) {
    			int prev = solve(y-1, j, k);
    			if (prev != Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
    				best = Math.min(best, prev + counts[i]);
    			}
    		}
    	}
    	dp[y][i][j] = best;
    	return best;
    }
    
    void execute() {
    	N = scan.nextInt();
    	M = scan.nextInt();
    	if (N < M) {
    		int temp = N;
    		N = M;
    		M = temp;
    	}
    	pow = 1<<M;
    	counts = new int[pow];
    	dp = new int[N][pow][pow];
    	for (int[][] i : dp) {
    		for (int[] j : i) {
    			Arrays.fill(j, -1);
    		}
    	}
    	for (int i = 0; i < pow; i++) {
    		counts[i] = Integer.bitCount(i);
    	}
    	int spiders = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
    	for (int i = 0; i < pow; i++) {
    		for (int j = 0; j < pow; j++) {
    			int val = solve(N-1, i, j);
    			if (val != Integer.MAX_VALUE && ((i|(i<<1)|(i>>1)|j)&(pow-1))==(pow-1)) {
    				spiders = Math.min(spiders, val);
    			}
    		}
    	}
    	out.println((N*M)-spiders);
    }
